question: Can even vast material wealth compare to the value of this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents immense wealth.
Such wealth is posed as a possible accumulation.
inference: Even the accumulation of an ocean full of jewels is not an adequate comparison.
uncertainties: akretuṃ is an unusual form; interpreted as related to making or acquiring
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to make the ocean filled with jewels.
